INTRONEW0.body:
"Greetings, $TITLE0 $NAME1. I am $TITLE2 $NAME3 of the $FACTION4,
and on this world my purpose is $MISSION6."

INTRONEW1.body:
"$TITLE0 $NAME1, at last. $NAME3 of the $FACTION4 speaks.
Know that I intend $MISSION6."

INTRONEW2.body:
"The $CHARACTERADJ9 $TITLE0 $NAME1, foremost of the $PEOPLE5!
I am $TITLE2 $NAME3, and the $FACTION4 $<4:is:are> glad of this contact.
We intend $MISSION6."

INTRONEW4.body:
"Well met, $TITLE0 $NAME1. $TITLE2 $NAME3 of the $FACTION4 greets you.
Our aim is $MISSION6."

INTRONEW5.body:
"$TITLE0 $NAME1. I, $TITLE2 $NAME3, speak for the $FACTION4.
We mean $MISSION6, and we will not be hindered."

items: "Shall we trade again on the same terms?"
"I seek your vote in the Council."
"Your forces are in my territory. Withdraw them."
"Let us sign a Treaty of Friendship."
"Give me the commlink frequencies you hold."
"Here is my loan repayment of $NUM0 credits."

REALLYBROKE.body: "Over!? $NAME0, after all we have been through?"

DROIDS.body: "Then let us say no more of it."

BROKEPACT.body: "So my $PACTKIN0 turns away. I will remember this, $TITLE1 $NAME2."

MAKEPACT.body:
"Then I, $TITLE0 $NAME1 of the $FACTION2, name you $PACTKIN3.
Together we will $YOURGOAL4 and $MYGOAL5."

MAKETREATY0.body:
"Agreed, $TITLE0 $NAME1. There is room on Planet for your $PROJECTS6
and my $PROJECTS7. Let the $FACTION2 and the $FACTION5 trade in peace."

MAKETREATY1.body:
"Very well. My $PROJECTS7 and your $PROJECTS6 can prosper side by side.
The $FACTION5 and the $FACTION2 are friends."

MAKETRUCE.body: "I, $NAME4 of the $FACTION5, pledge Blood Truce with the $FACTION2."

TALKTRADEPROMPT.body: "What do you offer, $TITLE0, and what do you ask?"

TALKOFFERVENDETTA.body: "I will pronounce Vendetta on your enemy."
